messages:
maria: heads up — we have ~$42k in promo credits on acct RED-678 that are set to expire next friday :calendar:  
ryan: ah ok. are those vendor/cloud promo credits or Redwood promo credits?
aj: most likely Redwood promotional credits from the q4 campaign. quick question — can we apply them retroactively to Dedicated reserved commits or only to Hosted usage?
billing-bot: automatic note: invoice INV-2026-03-08 posted for account RED-678, amount $12,345. Credits applied: $0. To view: https://billing.redwood.ai/accounts/RED-678/invoices/INV-2026-03-08
ben: we pushed a couple of large model runs to Dedicated this month. if credits are only for Hosted, they'll sit unused unless we move workload.
ryan: policy AFAIK: promo credits can be applied to hosted consumption only; contract credits (reserved capacity commitments) are separate. But we should confirm with ops-billing — sometimes there's a manual mapping for one-off migrations.
maria: timeline is tight though. if we can't map them, we either need to expend on Hosted or request extension. shifting non-prod training to Hosted this week could burn ~15k.
aj: quick feasibility check: can infra spin up batch windows on hosted? we can throttle but need cost guardrails.
ben: yes we can schedule low-priority runs to Hosted for next 5 days. will need a short config change: set job tag `billing_route: hosted-temp` and update batch queue.
maria: ok please patch the run scheduler. also can someone pull the credit metadata? I want the promo code id and expiry.
support-ops: pulling now — promo id PRM-Q42025-RED678, expiry 2026-03-13T23:59:59Z, balance $41,920, invoice exclusion flag = true (default).
ryan: invoice exclusion flag explains why billing shows $0 credits applied. support-ops, can that flag be toggled to allow credits against Dedicated?
support-ops: it is a metadata field controlled by finance; we can flip it on our side for Hosted vs Dedicated mapping but legal needs to sign off for reallocation to committed contracts.
maria: hmm legal will probably push back. fallback plan: schedule 120 GPU-hours of non-prod on Hosted immediately to consume credits. estimate ~ $16k.
aj: noted. I'll open a maintenance window and move the following job groups: `train-nightly`, `eval-batch`, `embedding-backfill`.
ben: also warn: moving embedding backfill to Hosted might trip rate limits, add `--concurrency 2`.
support-ops: opened internal ticket TKT-9876 to request credit reallocation inquiry with billing provider and internal finance. attaching invoice details and promo metadata.
support-ops: "curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/api/support/tickets -d '{\n  \"account\":\"RED-678\",\n  \"promo_id\":\"PRM-Q42025-RED678\",\n  \"invoice_id\":\"INV-2026-03-08\",\n  \"request\":\"allow promo credits to apply to Dedicated commit or extend expiry by 30 days.\"\n}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API_KEY'"
ryan: thanks. also can finance prepare a short justification doc for Legal? they'll want to see business impact and precedent.
maria: I'll draft a one-pager: current balance, intended Hosted burn plan, cost delta if not applied to Dedicated, and ask for 30-day extension.
aj: on infra side: ETA to spin jobs = 2 hours after green light. I'll add a temporary budget alert to avoid surprises.
ben: put a slack alert on #eng-alerts when consumption hits 50% of promo so finance knows.
support-ops: got it. ticket TKT-9876 updated, slack alert hook added.
maria: action items: (1) ryan/legal — escalate reallocation approval (due 48h), (2) aj/ben — schedule Hosted burn and set guardrails, (3) support-ops — follow up with billing provider and post updates in this thread.
ryan: I'll ping Legal now.
aj: will start prepping job changes, will post PR with `billing_route` changes.
ben: prepping concurrency and monitor dashboards.
maria: thanks folks :pray: — keep this thread alive with updates.
